t: This is St Margaret Pattens, a Church of England church on Eastcheap, near the Monument. It's dedicated to Saint Margaret of Antioch. Sir Christopher Wren designed it. After the Great Fire of 1666, he was given responsibility for rebuilding 52 City churches, and he also designed St Paul's Cathedral. Several people are buried here, among them Peter Vandeput, who died in 1668, and Jane Hoste, who died in 1672. Sir Peter Vandeput, who died in 1708, is buried here too.
